tasks.description: Implement a search bar in the Catalogue page to filter vehicles based on multiple fields like make, model, brand, description, and other details. Ensure a premium UI and responsive filtering.
acceptance_criteria: Catalogue page must feature a search input with id 'search-input'.
Search input must filter the car list in real-time as the user types.
Search must match the car's 'name' (e.g., searching 'Swift' should show Swift cars).
Search must match the car's 'brand' (e.g., searching 'Maruti' should show Maruti Suzuki cars).
Search must match the car's 'model' (e.g., searching 'Baleno' should show Baleno cars).
Search must match the car's 'description' text (e.g., searching 'scratchless' should show matching cars).
Search must match the car's 'fuel_type' (e.g., searching 'Diesel' should show diesel cars).
Search must match the car's 'transmission' (e.g., searching 'Automatic' should show automatic cars).
Search must match the car's 'body_type' (e.g., searching 'SUV' should show SUV cars).
Search must match the car's 'registration_city' or 'registration_state'.
Search must work in combination with the 'New' / 'Pre-Owned' condition filters.
Clearing the search input must restore the full list of available cars (subject to condition filters).
If no cars match the search query, a 'No matches found' message must be displayed.
The search input should have a placeholder 'Search by make, model, or details...'.
The search query should be able to match the 'model_year' of the car.
